text_block_list.text:
That news arrived just as the summer 
training camp was drawing to a close.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: …………What?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Craft won't wake up?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ha! No way! She's just being her usual 
sleepyhead self, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She really sleeps a lot, doesn't she? 
Maybe I should just shake her awake—

Looking at Cesario's expression, it was 
easy to see she wasn't joking... and that 
something serious was going on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……No.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No... that can't be...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They said nothing was physically 
wrong. It's just that... she won't wake 
up.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's already been a few days...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure you won't wake up? No 
matter what I do?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No matter what I do...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Listen to me, I'm sorry. Knowing you... 
you've already tried everything, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to hold off on telling you 
until the diagnosis was confirmed... I'm 
sorry for waiting so long."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Would you go see Craft? Maybe hearing 
your voice, Heart-san, will make her jump 
right awake."

For a while, Daring Heart... spent time by 
Rhein Kraft's side.
And—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's go. Tact is waiting in the 
mountains."
choice_data_list: Still... are you sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Craft will definitely awaken.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, if I were to waver... I couldn't 
call myself a Queen."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Because I know just how strong 
she is—better than anyone."

Daring Heart's voice was trembling. 
However, her eyes... remained unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...! Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I heard about it. ............Is 
it really alright for me to stay here?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It is fine. I simply do what I must do.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Because I believe in them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Tact, could you lend me your knife? I'll 
whittle some branches for the trap.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...You're quite strong, Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Let's do something else so we don't 
disturb her concentration.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? What a nice scent...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-saaan! Tonight's soup is ready! 
It's Trainer's nutrient-packed recipe!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll be right there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (...Craft.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(We promised... that this time for sure, 
we'd both become our best selves and clash 
in the Mile CS... didn't we?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I can wait. If it's for you, for as 
long as it takes... So...—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Please...

And so, this time around, Daring Heart 
spent the rest of the summer training camp 
up in the mountains.

And so—summer training camp came to an 
end. Taking a different bus from the other 
students, I finally returned to the 
Academy, and—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Cesario? What's wro—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Craft is awake! Just now...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh! Ah... Craft...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Geez. You really are such a sleepyhead!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah, gosh... nggh...! ...Thank goodness...—
choice_data_list: I'm really... so happy for you, Heart.
I'm really... so happy for you, Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
And so—everything went back to how it was.

All I can do now is return to my daily 
training with the goal of facing Rhein 
Kraft once more.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey... did you hear? About Rhein Kraft.
choice_data_list:
Ah, you mean about what didn't happen? If 
so—

You're talking about what didn't happen, 
right? If so—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not that! ...They said she can't run in 
races anymore.

Before checking the details, I rushed out. 
Does Daring Heart know about this? If she 
does, what must she be feeling right now—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Calm down. Could you tell me one more 
time?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Rumors like that have got to be lies, 
right? —That you can't run anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's true.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "To be precise, I can run. However..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I enter the gate, I just space 
out and all the strength leaves my body. 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I can't run in races anymore. ...Every 
single bit of it is true!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...That's a lie. That's strange, that 
makes no sense.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even right now, you're... totally normal. 
Besides, everyone zones out sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And yet, just because of that... I can't 
race? Hey, does that make any sense to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right? ...It really sounds like such a 
foolish story.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I tried so hard to do things right, you 
know? I... tried so many times. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Losing strength only inside the gates...? 
There's no way something so absurd could 
be true, right? That's why...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Time and time again—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Time and time again—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Time and time again—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Again and again...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —I tried...!! But it didn't work...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"All my strength just drained away... No 
matter how hard I tried, I couldn't 
resist...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said it was probably 
psychological... Since there's nothing 
physically wrong with me, they said...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, doesn't that make it even 
stranger?! I am...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even though I... gah, I want to run so 
badly...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even though... even though I want to run 
this much...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Heart-san, why? Why... did it have to 
turn out like this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Something so bizarre... Why me............ 
why?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Why... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Craft. When you're the one 
hurting the most..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
... ...No. I'm the one who should 
apologize.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why... With the other girls, I 
could smile and talk just fine...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"With Heart-san... it feels like I just 
want to pour out all my feelings to her."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry, Heart-san. I couldn't... 
keep our promise.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! No way! Craft, you're still—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: “My dream ends here! It's over now.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Craft, you still have it! You still 
have your dream...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The dream of carrying on the brilliance of 
your Tiara! With how you are now—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...I just don't understand anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It looks like... I can't be strong like 
you, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No, Craft, wait—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san, please. Starting tomorrow, can 
we just go back to being our usual 
selves?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even if we stop being rivals... we can 
still be friends, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —I'm sorry for leaving you all alone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Please just... leave me alone for now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I promise I'll come back to your side 
to rest. For now...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Craft... My rival. Strong, dazzling, 
precious... My rival.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(That was... everything I was running 
for...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "—Is that true, Cesario-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, Craft-san is...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Messiah. I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I will inherit Craft's dream. If I pave 
the way for the future—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Those kids will carry on Craft's feelings, 
too. ...That's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Cesario-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Would you... entrust that resolve to me 
as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Together, let us connect Craft-san's 
dream... to the future. —As rivals."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Passing on the dream. As a rival...――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: To the future.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ――... Um, Ms. Heart!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Do you... have a moment right now?
